title: Set password
purpose: Add a usable password to an account that does not currently have one.
summary: Add a password to your account when it does not have one yet.

tasks.title: Set a password
steps: Type it in [[Password]] and again in [[Password (again)]].
Select [[Set Password]]. You stay signed in on this browser.

tasks.title: Change an existing password
steps: If your account already has a password, this page opens Change password instead.

good_to_know: A new password needs at least 15 characters, or 8 if the laboratory requires a second sign-in factor of your account. The form states which.
Setting a password does not change your roles or client access.
Two-factor authentication stays as it was.

sections.title: Eligibility
paragraphs: Requires a signed-in account without a usable password. If the account already has one, the page redirects to Change Password. No current password is requested here.

items.label: Password
items.description: Required new password. The help under it states the rule for this account: at least 15 characters, or 8 where the laboratory's second sign-in factor rule covers the account, read again when you save. Refused: a common password; a common password (where it has at least four letters) or a name of the laboratory, the application or the account with only digits, symbols, spaces or letter case changed; one character or a text of fewer than 15 characters repeated; a run such as 123456789 or qwertyuiop; a password too similar to the username, names or email address. The whole password is compared, so a passphrase containing a common word is accepted. Letters of any language, digits, symbols and spaces count (the null character is refused), and there is no upper limit or required kind of character. The confirmation must match exactly. Errors keep the form open; password fields may need entering again.

items.label: Set Password
items.description: Creates a usable password, preserves this browser’s session and returns to Change Password with a success message. This does not issue roles, set client ownership or create an alternative login method.

sections.title: Limits
paragraphs: An account without a password still needs an available authorized sign-in or recovery method to reach this screen. Errors do not save a password. Password changes do not remove MFA.
